description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Warwick''' [[File:Bear Stance.png|20px|link=Dash#Lunge|An icon representing the keyword Lunge]] [[:Dash#Lunge|lunges]] at the target enemy over 0.264 seconds and bites them, dealing magic damage, [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|healing]] himself for a percentage of the post-mitigation damage dealt, applying [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] effects and [[File:Life steal icon.svg|15px|link=Life steal]] life steal, and triggering [[File:On-attack icon.svg|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Attacking|An icon representing the keyword On-attack]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Attacking|on-attack]] effects. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped against [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]].
description.text: Active: Warwick lunges at the target enemy over 0.264 seconds and bites them, dealing magic damage, healing himself for a percentage of the post-mitigation damage dealt, applying on-hit effects and  life steal, and triggering on-attack effects. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped against monsters.

description2.raw: While ''Jaws of the Beast'' is active, '''Warwick''' is [[File:Unstoppable icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Displacement_Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Displacement immune]] [[:Crowd control#Displacement_Immunity|displacement immune]] and clamps his jaw on the target, following '''all''' of their movement. The ability can be held for additional effects.
description2.text: While Jaws of the Beast is active, Warwick is displacement immune and clamps his jaw on the target, following all of their movement. The ability can be held for additional effects.

description3.raw: '''Hold:''' '''Warwick''' performs the bite, and then begins to [[File:Channeling icon.svg|20px|link=Channel|An icon representing the keyword Channel]] [[:Channel|charge]] for 0.5 seconds, extended if the target is under effects of a [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dash]] or [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|displacement]]. During the charge, he [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|leaps]] behind the target.
description3.text: Hold: Warwick performs the bite, and then begins to charge for 0.5 seconds, extended if the target is under effects of a dash or displacement. During the charge, he leaps behind the target.

This should not be confused with a [[cast time|cast ''time'']]. ** If the cast started beforehand, both the damage and the heal occur even after '''Warwick's''' [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|death]], or during [[File:Revival icon.png|20px|link=Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|An icon representing the keyword Resurrection]] [[:Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|resurrection]]. * If the target dies prior to '''Warwick''' reaching them, ''Jaws of the Beast'' refunds its cooldown when tapped. notes.text:
Details
Jaws of the Beast deals basic damage, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as spell damage.
Jaws of the Beast has a 0.264 seconds cast delay, which is the amount of time required for the bite to occur from the start of the cast. This should not be confused with a cast time.
* If the cast started beforehand, both the damage and the heal occur even after Warwick's death, or during resurrection.
If the target dies prior to Warwick reaching them, Jaws of the Beast refunds its cooldown when tapped. The ability can be still held, however, Warwick is no longer eligible for the refund in this case.
Editor's Note: The refund can occasionally fail. (bug)
* The mana cost is not refunded in either case.
The healing is calculated only from Jaws of the Beast's damage, while additional effects, such as on-hits, are not.
While the bite always occurs after the same delay, the time spent lunging does not, which depends on the range Jaws of the Beast was cast away from the target, up to 0.5 seconds when cast at maximum range.
* This does not affect the lockout timer, which is the same as the bite's delay.
The lunge always places Warwick to his attack range to the center of his target, while the dash will place him up to the edge of his attack range from the target's edge.
It has been special cased so Warwick never follows an enemy that uses a blink with a destination that is their spawn platform (such as Recall), or Sion when he respawns after his Glory in Death ends. This only applies to the charge when the ability is held.
Editor's Note: This may occasionally fail. The rule does not apply to the tapped cast; Warwick will still be able follow an enemy into their spawn if Jaws of the Beast was not held with its cast.(bug)
Jaws of the Beast's channel cannot be initiated while grounded or rooted. Warwick can only use the normal cast.
* The channel will not be interrupted by either of the two effects, despite the lock-on being a movement channel.
Interactions & Other
In order to hit the cap, the target monster needs to have at least 2500 / 2358 / 2250 / 2167 / 2100 health.
Jaws of the Beast is the only ability in the game that combines channeling with displacement immunity. Every interrupting crowd control effect that is not resisted by the displacement immunity will prematurely stop the dash.
* The bite can still occur if cast before the crowd control application, but Warwick cannot start channeling.
* Abilities that apply both stun and airborne at the same time will cause Warwick to ignore the displacement, but prematurely stop the channel and the dash.
** This occurs unless the ability's stun portion is able to be resisted by displacement immunity, in which case Warwick will ignore both the displacement and the stun and be able to continue the channel and dash.
Warwick will follow enemies that move via attachment effects but the lock-on will not be extended.
While Jaws of the Beast does not use Quick Casting by default, click-and-hold is comparable to the input required to use Bone Skewer or Comet Spear. It does not accept two-click input (e.g. First Cast and Recast) that abilities like Piercing Arrow or Decimating Smash use in Standard Casting.
Warwick will attempt to basic attack the target after a short delay.
The following table refers for interactions while Warwick is channeling:
* Flash, Teleport, Hexflash, and Recall are disabled during the first 0.4 seconds of the channel.
